If PostCreator.create returns nil (e.g., validation issue with skip_validations bypassed elsewhere), no TopicEmbed row is written and no error/log surfaces, so PollFeed will re-process the same feed item on every hourly run. Also, if a topic were partially created without a corresponding embed row, the duplicate-detection lookup (`TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first`) would miss it and a second topic could be created. adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, when `embed.blank?` it does `post = creator.create` and only creates the `TopicEmbed` row inside `if post.present?` (no else/log/marker). From the diff alone we can verify that a `nil`/blank return from `PostCreator#create` results in silent failure with no `TopicEmbed` record, meaning the same feed item will be retried on every poll (`TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first` will keep returning nil). However, the claim that this “can produce duplicate topics” is not verifiable from the diff because it depends on `PostCreator#create` side effects (whether it can create a Topic without returning a Post) which are not shown here.
